simple.meaning: תַּנְשֶׁמֶת (tanshemeth) is a Hebrew word meaning “properly, a hard breather , i.e. the name of two unclean creatures, a lizard and a bird (both perhaps from changing color through their irascibility), probably the tree-toad and the water-hen.” BibleIQ connects the English word back to this source word so its use can be compared across Scripture.
simple.biblicalBackground: תַּנְשֶׁמֶת (H8580) appears 3 times in the Hebrew Bible, beginning at Leviticus 11:18, with occurrences in Leviticus, Deuteronomy.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to תַּנְשֶׁמֶת (H8580) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: English translations can use the same English word for different Hebrew words. BibleIQ anchors the study in תַּנְשֶׁמֶת (H8580) before moving outward to related references.
